descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

调用InstallCloudAssistant接口后再调用[RebootInstance](~~25502~~)，安装云助手Agent的操作即可生效。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

After you call the InstallCloudAssistant operation to install Cloud Assistant Agent on an ECS instance, call the [RebootInstance](~~25502~~) operation to restart the instance to make the installation take effect.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs install-cloud-assistant --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1iudwa5b1tqa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
